SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
(  ( SELECT SUM("t0_t0"."stored_amount") AS "SUM__amount_"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") )  ) AS "total",
( EXISTS  ( SELECT 1 AS "_1"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id" AND "t0_t0"."stored_amount">:f2_minimum) )  ) AS "has_big"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( EXISTS  ( SELECT 1 AS "_1"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id" AND "t0_t0"."stored_amount">25) )  AND  ( SELECT SUM("t0_t0"."stored_amount") AS "SUM__amount_"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") )  > :f1_limit ) AS "big_total"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" + :offset AS outer_value,
(  ( SELECT SUM(( "t0_t0"."stored_amount" + :f3_offset )) AS "SUM__adjusted_"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id" AND "t0_t0"."stored_amount">:_s2_minimum) )  ) AS "local_total"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
(  ( SELECT SUM((  ( SELECT "t0_t0_t0"."rate" AS "rate"
 FROM "main"."sq_vat" AS "t0_t0_t0"

 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") )  ) AS "nested_total"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT (  ( SELECT SUM("t0_t0"."stored_amount") AS "SUM__amount_"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"

( (  ( SELECT SUM("t0_t0"."stored_amount") AS "SUM__amount_"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") )  ) * 2 ) AS "twice_total"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
WHERE ((  ( SELECT SUM("t0_t0"."stored_amount") AS "SUM__amount_"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") )  ) > :limit)
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
(  CAST( ( SELECT "t0_t0"."code" AS "code"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id")
ORDER BY "t0_t0"."id" DESC
LIMIT 1
OFFSET 1 ) AS TEXT)  ) AS "first_code"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
(  ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS "COUNT___"
 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"

 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"

 FROM "main"."sq_invoice" AS "t0_t0"
WHERE ("t0_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") )  ) AS "scalar_max"
 FROM "main"."sq_customer" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"
